snippet.title: Verdant | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
⭐ Wishlist Verdant on Steam! https://bit.ly/WishlistVerdantYT

Accompany Sprout on his journey through the green post-apocalyptic world of Verdant. Survive the beautiful yet harsh environment by building camps and upgrading your gear. Balance life and death literally in your hand with your powers and uncover its connection to the downfall of humanity.

🌏 Explore a changed world - while technology and culture have not moved on from the 80s, nature has mutated and the world is overgrown.

🎒 Ensure your survival  - Gather resources,  craft and upgrade your gear, and most importantly: plan ahead.

😶‍🌫️ Stay vigilant - rely on your wits and senses to outsmart your enemies. And make sure you don't alert them with a rumbling stomach!

🌿 Be the catalyst - Use Sprout’s unique powers to take and bestow life essence from nature and to shape the world around you.

Follow us on social media to keep up with all Verdant news:

Instagram:  https://www.instagram.com/tinyroargames/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/tinyroar
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@tinyroargames
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/tinyroargames.bsky.social
Tiny Roar: https://www.tinyroar.de/
Megabit Publishing: https://megabit-publishing.com/
